messages:
Maya: Quick pass on model catalog compare table — spotted a few small UX nits: resize affordance, pin wording, badge semantics, and chip keyboard flow. Short takes please.

Sam: The column divider is draggable but invisible. Users expect a grip. Can we show a visible handle on hover and make it keyboard-focusable? :eyes:

Olivia: I can mock a 6px handle with hover + focus states today. Also make it an explicit ARIA target.

Jordan: For keyboard, when the handle is focused support ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to nudge width. Add aria-describedby: "Left/Right to resize column".

Sasha: Badges are ambiguous — green used for multiple meanings. Propose: icon + color semantics: green=meets target, blue=cached, amber=warning, red=regress.

Aria: Pin copy is scary. CTA "Pin for compare" and tooltip "Keep this version visible in compare" reads clearer than "Pin version / Lock".

Maya: Also show a small pinned glyph in the compare header so pins aren't easy to miss. Tooltip: "Pinned — stays in compare".

Sam: Can users unpin directly from the header? Right now it's buried in the overflow menu.

Olivia: Make header pin a direct toggle for quick unpin. For org-level pins keep confirmation; otherwise quick toggle + undo toast.

Jordan: Accessibility: collapsed chips behind "More" lose tab order. Ensure More has aria-expanded and popped chips are first in DOM when expanded.

Sasha: Chip order — switch from recency to "most used" and add a tiny label "(sorted by usage)" so people know why order changed.

Maya: Plan: 1) handle + keyboard resize (Olivia) 2) badge tokens + icons (Sasha) 3) pin copy + header toggle + undo toast (Aria) 4) accessible chips + sort by usage (Jordan). Deliver prototypes EOW for quick usability test.

Olivia: I'll drop Figma frames today.

Sasha: Color + icon table by Thu.

Aria: Copy + toast text by Fri.

Jordan: Accessibility spec by Thu evening.

Maya: Thanks — I'll collect artifacts and open a PR description once mocks land. :rocket:
